name: Cart PDF – Quote PDF for WooCommerce + Drag and Drop Template Builder
author: add-ons.org

sections.description:
Document: https://pdf.add-ons.org/document-pdf-invoices-packing-slips-for-woocommerce-drag-and-drop-template-builder/

The Cart & Quote PDF for WooCommerce + Drag and Drop Template Builder plugin is a powerful tool designed to enhance the online shopping experience for WooCommerce stores. It enables users to create and customize PDF documents for cart summaries or quotes with ease, featuring a user-friendly drag-and-drop template builder. Below are the key features of the plugin:

Cart and Quote PDF Generation

  • Allows customers to download a PDF summary of their cart, including details such as product names, quantities, prices, and totals.
  • Supports generating PDFs for quote requests, enabling customers to save or share information before completing a purchase.
  • Drag-and-Drop Template Builder:== Cart and Quote PDF Generation ==
  • Offers an intuitive drag-and-drop interface for designing PDF templates without requiring coding skills.
  • Supports various elements like tables, QR codes, barcodes, text labels, page breaks, images, spacers, HTML content, and more, enabling the creation of professional, brand-aligned PDFs.

Flexible Customization

  • Users can customize layouts, colors, fonts, and logos to match their store’s branding.
  • Provides real-time previews of changes, ensuring the PDF output meets expectations.

Multilingual and RTL Support

  • Supports PDF generation in multiple languages, including complex scripts like Hebrew, Arabic, Thai, Japanese, Chinese, and Korean…
  • Compatible with right-to-left (RTL) languages.

Benefits

  • Enhanced Customer Experience: Provides shareable PDF summaries of carts or quotes, making it convenient for customers to save or reference.
  • Time-Saving: The drag-and-drop builder streamlines template design and management.
  • Professional Output: Creates polished, brand-consistent PDFs, boosting the store’s credibility.
  • Ideal for B2B businesses needing detailed quotes or product documentation.
  • Suitable for stores wanting to provide cart summaries before order completion.
  • Supports businesses requiring multilingual PDFs for international customers.

This plugin is a comprehensive solution for WooCommerce stores looking to enhance customization and customer communication through professional PDF documents.

sections.installation:
Normal installation

  1. Download the woocommerce.zip file to your computer.
  2. Unzip the file.
  3. Upload the plugin.zip directory to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  4. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
